add_locations.name: jo9_reference_panel
add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START REFERENCE_PANEL_SPACING_20261101 ! Inputs: description HTML, optional attitude HTML, optional existing prefix HTML. ! Only local copies are trimmed; saved NPC/place text and internal paragraph breaks remain intact. local $jo9_ref_body = $args[0] local $jo9_ref_attitude = $args[1] local $jo9_ref_prefix = $args[2] local $jo9_ref_empty = $strfind($jo9_ref_body, '^(\s| |<[bB][rR]\s*/?>)+') if $jo9_ref_empty ! '': $jo9_ref_body = $mid($jo9_ref_body, len($jo9_ref_empty) + 1, len($jo9_ref_body)) $jo9_ref_empty = $strfind($jo9_ref_attitude, '^(\s| |<[bB][rR]\s*/?>)+') if $jo9_ref_empty ! '': $jo9_ref_attitude = $mid($jo9_ref_attitude, len($jo9_ref_empty) + 1, len($jo9_ref_attitude)) $result = '
' + $jo9_ref_prefix if $jo9_ref_attitude ! '': $result += $jo9_ref_attitude + '
' $result += '' + $jo9_ref_body + '
' ! JO9 MOD END REFERENCE_PANEL_SPACING_20261101
